lines.en: Lesson 101
A card from Jimmy
Listen to the tape then answer this question.
Does grandmother seem pleased to get a card from Jimmy? Why/Why not?
lines.zh: 奶奶收到吉米的明信片似乎很高兴吗？为什么/为什么不？

lines.en: Read Jimmy's card to me please, Penny.
lines.zh: 请把吉米的明信片读给我听，潘妮。

lines.en: 'I have just arrived in Scotland and I'm staying at a Youth Hostel.'
lines.zh: “我刚到苏格兰，住在青年旅社。”

lines.en: Eh?
He says he's just arrived in Scotland.
He says he's staying at a Youth Hostel.
You know he's a member of the Y.H.A.
lines.zh: 你知道他是青年旅社协会的成员。

lines.en: The what?
The Y.H.A., Mum.
The Youth Hostels Association.
What else does he say?
'I'll write a letter soon.
I hope you are all well.'
What? Speak up, Penny.
I'm afraid I can't hear you.
lines.zh: 我恐怕听不清你说什么。

lines.en: He says he'll write a letter soon.
He hopes we are all well.
'Love, Jimmy.'
Is that all?
He doesn't say very much, does he?
He can't write very much on a card, Mum.
lines.zh: 他在明信片上写不了很多，妈妈。
